name: ReadValueFromRange
description: Reads one or more values from a specified range in a worksheet of an Excel file stored in OneDrive or SharePoint using the Microsoft 365 Excel API. Provide valid M365 credentials, the target Excel file's Drive and Item ID, worksheet name, and range address. The connector will return the values read from the specified range, along with the status code and message from the API.
author: @gaurav

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Excel API Credential
fields.description: Credential for authenticating with Microsoft 365 Excel API (requires tenant ID, client ID, and client secret).

fields.name: DriveAndItemId
fields.label: Excel File (Drive and Item ID)
fields.description: The Drive ID and Item ID of the Excel file in OneDrive or SharePoint to read the value from. Format: driveId/items/itemId.

fields.name: WorksheetName
fields.label: Worksheet Name
fields.description: The name of the worksheet in the Excel file to read the value from (e.g., 'Sheet1').

fields.name: RangeAddress
fields.label: Range Address
fields.description: The address of the range in the worksheet to read the value from (e.g., 'A1' or 'A1:B10').

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Read Result
fields.description: Returns the value(s) read from the specified range in the worksheet.
